{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
patient_counts = df['patient_id'].value_counts()
duplicates = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
num_duplicates = len(duplicates)
print(f"Number of patients with multiple rows: {num_duplicates}")
print(f"Duplicate patient IDs: {duplicates.index.tolist()}")

# Check sample_seq for each duplicate
print("\nSample_seq values for duplicate patients:")
df[df['patient_id'].isin(duplicates.index)].sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'])"}
